structure_control.help.title: Structure Control — administrator commands
structure_control.help.info: /structurecontrol info [x y z] — inspect structures at a position
structure_control.help.spawns: /structurecontrol spawns <structure> <off|on> [x y z] — toggle this instance
structure_control.help.confirm: /structurecontrol confirm <token> | cancel — confirm or cancel within 60 seconds
structure_control.help.undo: /structurecontrol undo — undo the latest world-wide change
structure_control.help.map: /structurecontrol map — open the optional client map
structure_control.error.data_invalid: Control data could not be loaded. Editing is disabled; inspect the server log.
structure_control.error.chunk_unloaded: Chunk %s, %s is not loaded. Move closer and try again.
structure_control.error.not_found: No registered %s structure at this position.
structure_control.error.ambiguous: Several overlapping %s structures were found. Select one on the map.
structure_control.error.too_large: This structure is too large for the undo journal; no changes were made.
structure_control.error.confirmation_mis: No matching confirmation. Prepare the operation again.
structure_control.error.confirmation_exp: Confirmation expired. Prepare the operation again.
structure_control.error.structure_change: The structure changed after the operation was prepared. No changes were made.
structure_control.error.restore_failed: The original structure cannot be restored with the current registries. History was kept.
structure_control.error.no_history: There are no changes to undo.
structure_control.error.position_require: Console commands require explicit x y z coordinates.
structure_control.error.player_required: This command must be run by a player.
structure_control.error.client_missing: The map requires Structure Control on your client. Server commands remain available.
structure_control.error.server_missing: This server does not provide Structure Control.
structure_control.error.rate_limit: Please wait before requesting another update.
structure_control.info.no_overrides: This structure has no special mob spawn lists.
structure_control.spawns.changed: Structure spawns for %s at start chunk %s, %s: %s. Blocks and registration were kept.
structure_control.preview.warning: Unregister %s at start chunk %s, %s? Blocks stay, but structure detection and locating change. Undo retains the last %s operations.
structure_control.preview.hover: Click to confirm. Valid for 60 seconds.
structure_control.unregistered: Unregistered %s at start chunk %s, %s. Blocks were kept.
structure_control.list.truncated: Only the first 100 entries are shown. Use the map for a local view.
structure_control.ui.title: Structure Control
structure_control.ui.choose: Select a structure on the map
structure_control.ui.loaded_only: Loaded chunks only. Drag to pan; scroll to zoom.
structure_control.ui.click_cycle: Click again to cycle overlapping structures.
structure_control.ui.confirm_warning: Unregistering also affects structure detection and /locate. Blocks stay.
structure_control.ui.truncated: Too many structures in view. Zoom in.
structure_control.error.request_timeout: The server did not reply. Try refreshing the map.
structure_control.error.no_overrides: This structure has no special mob spawn lists.
